release_target: Mac-first Pantheon operational foundation across CLI, TUI, MCP, native application, menu bar, dashboard, and governed SNE lifecycle integration

criteria: The affected operator, developer, agent, node, fleet, or consuming Sirsi product workflow is named and demonstrated through the authoritative Pantheon engine.
CLI, TUI, MCP, native Mac application, menu bar, and retained dashboard surfaces expose one authoritative state and do not duplicate business logic.
SNE integration preserves Pantheon ownership of discovery, signed admission, verified acquisition, lifecycle, readiness, memory and swap care, diagnostics, updates, rollback, removal, and recovery.
Every affected human surface includes a clear primary action, progress, empty state, failure explanation, actionable recovery, and verification result.
The native Mac experience is accessible, consent-based, coherent with the web and terminal surfaces, and does not present internal tooling as a finished product.
Mutating operations explain scope and consequences and require the narrow authorization defined by canon.
Shared engine contracts, identity, authorization, validation, errors, concurrency, compatibility, and fail-closed behavior are covered by focused and integration tests.
No feature silently falls back across local, cloud, CPU, GPU, model, precision, framework, account, or trust boundaries.
Package, catalog, model, runtime, helper, and dependency identities are durable, relocatable, and cryptographically verifiable where applicable.
Install, upgrade, rollback, removal, clean uninstall, restart recovery, diagnostics, support, and clean-host behavior are proven for every supported distribution path and device tuple.
Developer ID signing, notarization, GitHub and Homebrew delivery, permitted Mac App Store disposition, privacy, security, accessibility, and recovery evidence are recorded before GA.
Node and fleet operations remain bounded, observable, reversible, and usable when cloud or upper-layer services disappear.
A stranger can understand what changed, which Pantheon responsibility owns it, who benefits, what was measured, and how to reproduce the result.
Public, owner, investor, and support materials distinguish proven product behavior from prototypes, research, proxies, inherited substrate improvements, and unsupported scope.
Material canon is linked across repository authority, the Owner Reading Room, and Sirsi Google Workspace or carries a visible synchronization blocker.
